user_story_title: receive and validate Real-Time Inventory Snapshots from Store Partners to update the central Product Catalog
user_story_description: The system shall receive and validate Real-Time Inventory Snapshots from Store Partners to update the central Product Catalog.

business_value: Accurate availability data reduces failed deliveries and protects revenue, while harm occurs if overselling leads to customer dissatisfaction and financial loss.

Meeting this need reduces inventory shrinkage and waste while improving customer satisfaction through accurate stock availability; failure results in overselling, financial loss, and reputational damage.
Meeting this requirement drives repeat usage and high ratings, while failure results in lost revenue and reputational damage due to spoiled goods or late arrivals.
Meeting this requirement prevents missed delivery windows, customer churn, and potential regulatory breaches, while failing to do so risks significant financial loss and reputational damage.
Prevents failed deliveries and revenue leakage while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

feature_name: The system shall maintain synchronized, real-time inventory levels across all Store/Fulfillment Centers to prevent overselling of perishable goods and ensure accurate stock visibility.
epic_title: Ensure accurate inventory availability to maintain high customer satisfaction and prevent financial loss from uncollectible orders.

business_rules.name: Perishable Allocation Priority
business_rules.condition: When allocating inventory for an Order Request containing fresh perishables
business_rules.statement: The system must prioritize allocation of perishable items to new Order Requests based on their proximity to the expiration date.
exceptions: Items flagged as expired are excluded from allocation

business_rules.name: Expired Item Order Rejection
business_rules.condition: During the Order Request creation or validation phase
business_rules.statement: An Order Request must not be successfully created if it contains any item where the current date is later than the item's defined expiry date.
exceptions: None

business_rules.name: Stock Lock Release Timeout
business_rules.condition: When an Order Request remains in a 'pending confirmation' state
business_rules.statement: Locked stock must be automatically released if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner for specific high-value orders

business_rules.name: Sync Discrepancy Flagging
business_rules.condition: During real-time inventory synchronization cycles
business_rules.statement: The system must flag a synchronization discrepancy if the data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
exceptions: Scheduled maintenance windows where sync is paused

business_rules.name: Service Area Boundary Compliance
business_rules.condition: When an incoming order request is received for delivery
business_rules.statement: Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition must be rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
exceptions: Manual override for VIP customers or special promotions

business_rules.name: Target Timeframe Adherence
business_rules.condition: When an order reaches the Delivery Proof confirmation stage
business_rules.statement: The system must classify an order as fulfilled only if the total elapsed time from Order Request creation to Delivery Proof confirmation does not exceed the committed target window.
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by the Regulatory Authority
Customer-initiated order cancellation prior to handover

business_rules.name: Service Area Activation Prerequisite
business_rules.condition: When a customer or partner initiates an Order Request
business_rules.statement: The system must prevent the creation of a new Order Request if the associated Service Area Definition is not in an active state.
exceptions: Emergency override protocols authorized by the Platform Operator
System maintenance windows explicitly approved by the Regulatory Authority

business_rules.name: Delivery Partner Performance Threshold
business_rules.condition: When a Delivery Partner completes a batch of deliveries
business_rules.statement: The system must suspend a Delivery Partner's ability to accept new assignments if their on-time delivery rate falls below the minimum acceptable threshold within a rolling evaluation period.
exceptions: Temporary suspension due to verified force majeure events
New partner probationary period grace window defined in contract

business_rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Consistency
business_rules.condition: When an Order Request is submitted for processing
business_rules.statement: The system must invalidate an Order Request if the real-time inventory snapshot indicates that any selected item is unavailable at the assigned Store Partner.
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for high-priority customer orders
System latency tolerance window defined in the SLA agreement

business_rules.name: Real-time Inventory Consistency
business_rules.condition: during order allocation to a store
business_rules.statement: The system must prevent any order assignment if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates insufficient quantity for all requested items.

business_rules.name: Discrepancy Investigation Threshold
business_rules.condition: during periodic inventory reconciliation or upon manual count upload
business_rules.statement: The system must automatically trigger a Discrepancy Alert when the difference between physical stock counts and system records exceeds the configured tolerance limit.
exceptions: scheduled maintenance windows

business_rules.name: Overselling Incident Escalation
business_rules.condition: when an overselling event is confirmed via audit or customer dispute
business_rules.statement: The system must escalate any confirmed overselling incident to the Compliance Officer immediately, regardless of the order status.

business_rules.name: Partial Fulfillment Restriction
business_rules.condition: when inventory is insufficient for the full order but sufficient for some items
business_rules.statement: The system must not allow an order to proceed with partial fulfillment unless the customer explicitly consents to a split shipment.
exceptions: customer opt-in for split shipment

business_rules.name: Minimum Order Value Validation
business_rules.condition: at the moment of Order Request submission
business_rules.statement: The system must reject an Order Request submission if the sum of item prices is strictly less than the minimum order value dynamically retrieved from the Store Partner Agreement.
exceptions: Promotional codes explicitly overriding the minimum order value in the agreement

business_rules.name: Loyalty Point Redemption Cap
business_rules.condition: when a customer attempts to apply loyalty points during checkout
business_rules.statement: A customer must not redeem loyalty points for a single order if the points value exceeds the maximum allowed discount percentage for that order total.
exceptions: Promotional events explicitly override standard caps

business_rules.name: Atomic Inventory Locking
business_rules.condition: When an Order Request is created and assigned to a Store Partner
business_rules.statement: A specific inventory unit must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the fulfillment task is completed or the order is cancelled.

business_rules.name: Perishable Priority Allocation
business_rules.condition: When allocating inventory for perishable goods across multiple eligible orders
business_rules.statement: Inventory units for perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to orders based on their proximity to the expiration date.
exceptions: Customer explicitly requests older stock

business_rules.name: Real-Time Sync Discrepancy Flagging
business_rules.condition: During continuous reconciliation between POS systems and the digital platform
business_rules.statement: The system must flag a synchronization discrepancy if the data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
exceptions: Scheduled maintenance window

business_rules.name: Automatic Lock Release on Timeout
business_rules.condition: When an Order Request remains in a pending confirmation state
business_rules.statement: Locked stock must be automatically released if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
exceptions: Manual override by Store Partner

business_rules.name: Food Safety Certificate Validity
business_rules.condition: When processing an order request for a specific Store Partner
business_rules.statement: A Store Partner must not accept new orders unless their food safety certificate is valid and non-expired.
exceptions: Certificate renewal grace period defined by local law (proposed)

business_rules.name: High-Velocity Inventory Safety Margin
business_rules.condition: when calculating inventory availability for high-velocity products against projected demand
business_rules.statement: The system must only flag a synchronization discrepancy for high-velocity items when the projected demand exceeds current inventory by the defined safety margin.
exceptions: during manual inventory adjustment processes
for items explicitly marked as 'non-critical' in the product catalog

business_rules.name: Jurisdictional Tax Rate Cap
business_rules.condition: during Order Request validation
business_rules.statement: The system must not finalize an Order Request if the calculated tax rate exceeds the maximum threshold defined by the Regulatory Authority.
exceptions: Manual override by Compliance Officer for documented regulatory changes

business_rules.name: Agreement Activation Gate
business_rules.condition: when an order is routed to a specific store
business_rules.statement: An Order Request may only be allocated to a Store Partner if the associated Partner Agreement is explicitly marked as 'Active' in the system.
exceptions: Emergency manual override by Platform Operator with audit trail

business_rules.name: Immediate Order Locking on Failure
business_rules.condition: when a system failure or data corruption is detected during order preparation or allocation
business_rules.statement: The system must immediately release all stock locks associated with an Order Request upon detection of a system outage or data corruption event.
exceptions: manual override by a senior operations manager for high-value orders

business_rules.name: Perishable Priority Allocation
business_rules.condition: when allocating stock to multiple concurrent Order Requests
business_rules.statement: Perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to Order Requests based on their proximity to the expiration date.
exceptions: manual override by store manager for high-margin non-perishable substitution

business_rules.name: Service Area Pre-Activation Validation
business_rules.condition: when an Order Request is submitted for a specific geographic zone
business_rules.statement: A Service Area Definition must not be used to validate new Order Requests unless it is in an active state.
exceptions: Emergency override protocols defined in FR-050

business_rules.name: Refund Precondition
business_rules.condition: During the financial settlement phase of a dispute
business_rules.statement: Financial adjustments must not be finalized until the Dispute Ticket is marked as Resolved.
exceptions: Emergency regulatory override

business_rules.name: Predictive Demand Threshold Enforcement
business_rules.condition: when allocating inventory for a new Order Request
business_rules.statement: The system must not allocate inventory to an Order Request if the predictive demand model forecasts a stockout probability exceeding the configured safety margin within the target delivery window.
exceptions: Emergency override by Platform Operator with audit trail

business_rules.name: Expiry-Driven Allocation Priority
business_rules.condition: when multiple stores or items can fulfill an Order Request
business_rules.statement: The system must prioritize the allocation of 'nearing expiry' items to incoming Order Requests over items with longer remaining shelf life, provided the item is within the configured safety margin.
exceptions: Customer explicitly requests non-expiring items

business_rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Verification
business_rules.condition: During order allocation to a Store Partner
business_rules.statement: An order must only be assigned to a store if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.

business_rules.name: Nearest Store Prioritization
business_rules.condition: When allocating an order to multiple eligible stores
business_rules.statement: The system must prioritize the nearest store based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time when multiple stores have sufficient inventory.

business_rules.name: Immediate Inventory Lock Release
business_rules.condition: When an Order Request is cancelled
business_rules.statement: Inventory locks must be released immediately upon confirmation of cancellation before the Fulfillment Task status changes to 'Ready for Dispatch'.
exceptions: If the Order Request has already been handed over to a Delivery Partner

business_rules.name: Nearing Expiry Allocation Priority
business_rules.condition: When allocating stock for a new Order Request containing perishable goods
business_rules.statement: Perishable items approaching shelf-life limits must be prioritized for allocation to new Order Requests over items with longer remaining shelf life.
exceptions: If the prioritized item is flagged as 'nearing expiry' and the system is configured to reject such orders to prevent waste

business_rules.name: Expiry-Flagged Item Rejection
business_rules.condition: When validating inventory availability for an Order Request against a Store Partner
business_rules.statement: An Order Request must not be assigned to a Store Partner if the primary fulfillment source contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry'.
exceptions: If the Store Partner explicitly overrides the rejection via a manual quality validation process after confirming the item is still fit for sale

business_rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Deduction
business_rules.condition: Upon successful assignment of an Order Request to a Store Partner
business_rules.statement: Inventory quantities reserved by an automatic Order Request assignment must be immediately deducted from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
exceptions: If the assignment is subsequently cancelled or the order is rejected before the fulfillment task begins

business_rules.name: Active Agreement Requirement
business_rules.condition: During order allocation to a specific store partner
business_rules.statement: Order Requests must not be allocated to a Store Partner unless the associated Store Partner Agreement is in an 'Active' state.
exceptions: Emergency manual override with senior management approval (proposed)

business_rules.name: Expiry Risk Order Rejection
business_rules.condition: during Order Request creation and validation
business_rules.statement: An Order Request must not be created if it contains any item flagged as 'nearing expiry' in the primary fulfillment source.
exceptions: Customer explicitly opts-in to purchase 'nearing expiry' items at a discounted rate, if configured

business_rules.name: Stock Lock Release Timing
business_rules.condition: after the allocated confirmation time window expires
business_rules.statement: Locked stock associated with an Order Request must be automatically released if the Order Request remains unconfirmed within the allocated time window.
exceptions: Manual override by a Store Partner manager for exceptional circumstances

business_rules.name: Single-Order Stock Locking
business_rules.condition: When a Fulfillment Task is created for an Order Request
business_rules.statement: A specific stock quantity must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the Fulfillment Task is completed or the Order Request is cancelled.
exceptions: System-wide inventory freeze during maintenance

business_rules.name: Active State Requirement
business_rules.condition: when validating an Order Request against a Service Area Definition
business_rules.statement: A Service Area Definition may only be used to validate new Order Requests when it is explicitly marked as active.
exceptions: legacy orders in transition period

business_rules.name: Allocation Eligibility Threshold
business_rules.condition: at the moment of order assignment or validation
business_rules.statement: An incoming Order Request may only be assigned to a Store Partner if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items.
exceptions: manual override by a Store Manager for high-priority customers

business_rules.name: Slot Validity on Route Constraint
business_rules.condition: When external logistics data signals a route constraint for the assigned path
business_rules.statement: The system must invalidate an Assigned Delivery Slot if external network data indicates a route constraint.
exceptions: Manual override by Platform Operator for critical orders

Network connectivity at Store Partners is stable and reliable.
Network latency does not exceed 200ms during peak hours.
SKU definitions are consistent across physical and digital catalogs.
Store Partners have redundant connectivity to report local system failures.
Store partners maintain accurate real-time inventory levels

Store Partners provide timely updates on inventory levels and shelf-life data.
Store Partners will provide API access to their POS systems.
The Order Allocation Engine includes automated health monitoring capabilities.
The Payment Provider supports rapid transaction reversal upon failure detection.

Real-time synchronization is mandatory for perishable goods.
Reports must be generated in real-time or near real-time to support immediate decision-making.
Rollback procedures must be validated by the Platform Operator before deployment.
System must support offline POS fallback with automatic sync upon reconnection.

business_rules: Stock quantities must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the fulfillment task is completed or the order is cancelled.
